name: cred-stats
description: Personal statement analytics for India — NestJS API, React app, MongoDB.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cred-stats/backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:backend && npm run seed -w @cred-stats/backend
scripts.fixtures:build: npm run build:backend && npm run fixtures:build -w @cred-stats/backend
